name: ARO
description: ARO is a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate vision-language models' understanding of compositional information, including attributes, relations, and order sensitivity. It consists of Visual Genome Attribution, Visual Genome Relation, and COCO&Flickr30k-Order subsets, with over 50,000 test cases.
reputation: ARO is a well-known benchmark for compositional vision-language understanding and is commonly used to probe attribute, relation, and order sensitivity in multimodal models.
notes: Benchmark highlights limitations of current VLMs in compositional understanding and proposes composition-aware hard negative mining to improve performance.
